name: spamcalls.net caller reports (manual pivot links)
tier_rationale: Community user-report site with an identifiable operator (imprint and privacy policy on /en/page/contact) and public activity since 2018 (A8 community); P128 cond 5 'spamcalls.net community'.

reliability.justification: Anonymous user reports about callers, unverified ('user reports, unverified', P128 cond 1): leads for the analyst, never evidence.

num_page.title: spamcalls.net number page /en/num/{e164 digits} (user reports, unverified; manual pivot link)

terms.quote: spamcalls.net (https://spamcalls.net/en/num/{e164}, labelled 'user reports, unverified') ... V3LUM never fetches any of these links.

num_page.notes: Quote: binding council text (P128 cond 1); research C0297 terms 'spamcalls.net ToS' (verified_live 200; a 410 'User reports for the phone number are not (no longer) available.' is the normal no-reports page). The template uses the digits without '+' (a literal '+' in the path is decoded as a space, verified 2026-11-26). Manual link only (pack phone:spamcalls_num): V3LUM never fetches it. Opening it from the analyst's browser sends the number to spamcalls.net, its log files and its ad/analytics partners (privacy policy), hence reuses_queries=true; number pages also show public per-number request counters and a 'currently high activity' list: legal_dpo decides whether that is publishes_queries (rule 7) before release (docs/backlog/p1-G06-1.md). Used by pivots_phone.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G06-1 (P128). Manual pivot links only: V3LUM never requests spamcalls.net. Phone values are PERSONAL_TYPES: the phone pack link is privacy=true (analyst-typed seeds of an opted-in case) and renders as text with 'opening sends <number> to spamcalls.net' at TLP:AMBER and above (A2).
